preconditions.description: The number of affected settlements m is between 1 and n, and n is between 1 and 100000.
The damage range d is between 0 and n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in p)
preconditions.description: Each affected settlement pi is between 1 and n.
The number of affected settlements in the list p is exactly m.
The number of paths is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n for ai, bi in paths)
preconditions.description: Each endpoint of a path ai and bi is between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The number of possible settlements containing the Book of Evil is between 0 and n.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(any(abs(i - j) <= d for j in p) for i in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: The return value is the count of settlements i such that there exists an affected settlement j with distance at most d.
